title: 第564章 趁热打铁彻底拿下第563章 实力不够但我的演员多呀
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
第564章趁热打铁，彻底拿下！
“小畜生，你以为我是什么人？”
“想要用言出法随控制我，你……”
九千岁话说到这里，突然直接跪倒在了李青幽的面前，恭敬地行礼。
但脸上却是浮现出震惊的表情。
口中更是下意识地惊呼：“不，不可能，怎么会这样？！”
“你到底是什么实力，怎么会这么强大？”
“老奴，拜见女帝大人！”
麻了！
李青幽彻底地麻了！
毕竟，人的名，树的影！
九千岁到底是个何等恐怖的存在，生活在大周仙朝内的人都知道。
这可是一尊，极其牛逼的亚圣呀！
结果这样的存在，却在沈浪的言语命令下，直接给她跪了，并且喊她陛下！
我超了个DJ的呀！
这一手操作，未免也太牛逼了吧？
察觉到李青幽情绪的变化。
沈浪此刻也是趁热打铁道：“你现在还对我的实力，存在质疑吗？”
“不不不不……”李青幽直接将自己的脑袋摇成了拨浪鼓。
毕竟，九千岁都跪了，她还有什么质疑的。

“那你愿意与我合作，推翻这腐朽的大周，成为新的女帝吗？”
“这……”
李青幽尴尬地张了张嘴，不知道该如何地回答。
毕竟，她承认沈浪很牛逼。
但她有多少本事，她自己清楚得很呀！
凭借她的本事，想要推翻大周仙朝，成为新的女帝。
这种事情，她做梦都不敢去想。
只能在语塞数秒后，尴尬至极道：
“承蒙宰相大人您看得起，我其实就是一个被男人骗的傻女人，怕是无法撑得起您的计划呀！”
见李青幽还挺有自知之明的，沈浪心底也不由得感叹，的确是个聪明的敌人。
但现阶段，他能够找到的替代者实在是太少了。
他也只能逮着李青幽一个人薅！
“丫头，你不用怕，我会帮助你的！”
“只要你按照我说的去做，我不仅可以帮助你成为大周女帝，更是可以抹除你嫁给崔勇的黑历史，恢复名声，让你与你的父母相认，重归于好！”
咕噜……
正所谓，当利益超过百分之百的时候，人就能冒着被杀头的风险去搞事。
在李青幽心底，一直以来都有个疙瘩！
content_en:
Chapter 564: Strike while the iron is hot and win it completely!
"Little beast, who do you think I am?"
"If you want to control me with your words, you..."
When Jiu Qiansui said this, he suddenly knelt down in front of Li Qingyou and saluted respectfully.
But there was a shocked expression on his face.
He even subconsciously exclaimed: "No, it's impossible, how could this happen?!"
"What is your strength? How can you be so powerful?"
"Old slave, pay homage to the Empress!"
Numb!
Li Qingyou was completely numb!
After all, a person’s name is like the shadow of a tree!
Everyone who lives in the Great Zhou Immortal Dynasty knows how terrifying Nine Thousand Years Old is.
This is an extremely awesome sub-sage!
As a result, such a being, under Shen Lang's verbal command, knelt down directly for her and called her "Your Majesty!"
I'm better than a DJ!
This one-hand operation is too awesome, right?
Noticed the change in Li Qingyou's mood.
Shen Lang was also striking while the iron was hot at this moment: "Do you still have any doubts about my strength now?"
"No, no, no, no..." Li Qingyou shook his head directly into a rattle.
After all, she has knelt down for nine thousand years, so why does she have any doubts.
"Then are you willing to cooperate with me to overthrow this decadent Zhou Dynasty and become the new empress?"
"This..."
Li Qingyou opened his mouth awkwardly, not knowing how to answer.
After all, she admitted that Shen Lang was awesome.
But she knows very well how much she is capable of!
With her ability, she wants to overthrow the Great Zhou Immortal Dynasty and become the new empress.
She never dared to think about such a thing.
After being speechless for a few seconds, he could only say in utter embarrassment:
"Thank you, Prime Minister, for your consideration. I am actually just a stupid woman who was deceived by a man. I'm afraid I won't be able to support your plan!"
Seeing that Li Qingyou was quite self-aware, Shen Lang couldn't help but sigh in his heart, he was indeed a smart enemy.
But at this stage, he can find too few replacements.
He could only catch Li Qingyou alone!
"Girl, don't be afraid, I will help you!"
"As long as you do what I say, I can not only help you become the Empress of the Great Zhou Dynasty, but I can also erase the dark history of your marriage to Cui Yong, restore your reputation, and allow you to recognize your parents and get back together!"
Gulu...
As the saying goes, when the benefits exceed 100%, people can risk their heads to cause trouble.
There has always been a knot in Li Qingyou's heart!
